stalls.summaryZh: 香腸裡塞飛魚卵，咬下有啵啵的爆卵口感並帶淡淡酒香，是大街上最常被點名的平價小吃；賣完就收。
stalls.summaryEn: Sausage stuffed with flying fish roe that pops as you bite, with a faint liquor aroma. The most-cited cheap snack on the street; closes when sold out.
